generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.metadata AS content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN generic_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.database_name IN ('stories', 'journal', 'cpj')
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%international%' 
    OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%au%' 
    OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%australia%'
    OR LOWER(g.metadata) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.metadata) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.metadata) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(g.metadata) LIKE '%au%'
    OR LOWER(g.metadata) LIKE '%australia%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;
